quote:
You spend years building walls around your fragile heart. 
You fear the cold touch of sudden loss. 
You hide behind a mask of careful indifference. 
Yet you still crave the warmth of human contact. 
Then someone gentle finally slips past your heavy guard. 
They leave you wondering if safety was worth the loneliness.
